scope: CPU-only full FIM/producer gathering comparison: global versus stream-local pressure knots and compact singleton trunk policy. Identical physical model within each pair, independent material audits.

audit.scope:
Accepted producer-only FIM -> gathering material/operating audit.

No solver invocation or rescaling of requested production. This is accounting
and constraint checking, not independent PVT/correlation validation.

grid_policy.scope:
Full FIM reference comparison: global versus stream-local pressure knots.

Both variants use current PVTO lookup/admission and identical physical inputs.
Only the grid factory is changed in memory for the benchmark process.
